title: Merkle-less Sync
tagline: Compare integrity schemes for large-file replication using non-Merkle alternatives.
yAxisLabel: Integrity work cost (0-100 scale, higher worse)

curves.label: Chunk CRC Chain
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ crc[i]=crc32(buf[i]); chain = rotl(chain,5) ^ crc[i]; } return chain;
curves.name: Chunk CRC Chain

curves.label: Rolling Rabin Fingerprints
curves.code: let fp=0; let window=[]; for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ fp = (fp*B + h(buf[i])) % M; if(i>=w) fp=(fp + M - h(window.shift())*powB) % M; window.push(buf[i]); } return fp;
curves.name: Rolling Rabin Fingerprints

let h=0; for (let i=0;i<k;i++) h = h*1315423911 ^ hash(data[i]); for (let i=0;i<parity;i++) h ^= hash(parityBlk[i]); return h;

curves.label: Bloom-Filter Integrity
curves.code: m = Math.ceil(alpha*n*Math.log(n+1)); k = Math.max(1,Math.ceil((m/n)*Math.log(2))); for(i=0;i<n;i++) for(j=0;j<k;j++) bits[hashj(buf[i],j)%m]=1; return bitsHash(bits);
curves.name: Bloom-Filter Integrity
